messages:
Noah: Heads-up: UX wants a tiny runtime hint in the saved-queries list (model, routing tier, cost bucket). Low visual weight.
Ivy: Support is asking for this too. Do we have decent telemetry to back a cost bucket?
Sam: We do. Per-route length p90 + model per-token cost table gives a reasonable estimate. Prefer precompute.
Noah: UX: show model pill + cost(low/med/high) + route tag; tooltip links to docs and says 'estimate'. Keep accessibility text.
Jo: Infra: add optional `runtime_hint` to saved_query metadata. Populate via nightly job merging histograms with cost profiles. Version schema v1.
Sam: API: runtime_hint optional, include `hint_schema_version` and `estimated_confidence` (low/med/high). Provide bulk hints endpoint to avoid N+1.
InfraBot: job: saved-query-hint-generator:v1 scheduled nightly at 2024-11-15T02:00:00Z.
Ivy: Rollout: feature flag + 5% canary. If confidence low, hide cost badge and show only model pill. Also add quick feedback button.
Noah: I'll mock the compact badge and hover copy. Ping me when PR is ready for review.
Sam: Will open PR and add migration notes. Tagging @Jo for infra changes.
